n_agm_87ca77b2e2.title: Training plan for the quarter
n_agm_87ca77b2e2.content: Complaints refresher on 22 October for everyone. Data protection e-learning by the 30th. Two places on the November spreadsheet course.

n_agm_7eb47d709d.title: One-to-one prompts
n_agm_7eb47d709d.content: Workload and leave plans; progress on development goals; anything the team should stop doing?

n_agm_3d8d61dc72.title: Christmas cover
n_agm_3d8d61dc72.content: Office open 29 to 31 December with a small team. Ask for volunteers before the end of November.

n_agm_c486666579.title: Car share
n_agm_c486666579.content: Callum and Gareth share from the north side of town; Nina can give a lift on Tuesdays.

n_agm_95f8d2e7b0.title: Floor 3 move checklist
n_agm_95f8d2e7b0.content: Clear desks on Wednesday 11 November. Crates labelled with name and desk. IT moves phones over the weekend. Check the new plan on Monday.

n_agm_7dc7eb8505.title: Welcome plan for new starters
n_agm_7dc7eb8505.content: A buddy for each, a first-week timetable, laptop collection on day one and a short visit to every team in the first month.

n_agm_7e7cea0c8c.title: Team away day
n_agm_7e7cea0c8c.content: Half a day at the outdoor centre in the spring, then a pub lunch. Ask for a budget in January.

n_agm_92c507bcb7.title: Desk tidy Fridays
n_agm_92c507bcb7.content: Ten minutes at 16:00 every Friday so the hot desks are clear for Monday.

n_agm_f3a4e1119a.title: Lunch and learn topics
n_agm_f3a4e1119a.content: Spreadsheet shortcuts, plain English writing, how pricing works, and a session from the complaints team.

n_agm_16f53e8278.title: Thank-you board
n_agm_16f53e8278.content: A board in the kitchen for thank-you notes between teams.
